summary.executive_summary: The existing V3-era tools and V4.0 milestones 36-40 have verifiable working parts. V4.0 milestones 41-55, V5.0 milestones 56-75, and V7.0 milestones 76-85 were not found in source/tests. V6 multi-app tooling is partial and has a reproducible cross-app artifact attribution defect. Debug tests/builds pass, but production signing, AI provider integrations, AAB, store approval, privacy and production evidence are absent.

milestones.evidence: Fresh Android scaffold generated; identity wiring verified; generated sample analyzed, tested, built, installed and launched on emulator.
App title/brand seed and store asset inventory generated. Actual store artwork, screenshots, listing materials and license approval absent.
Three Android flavors and Dart environment configuration generated; development flavor built and launched. Staging/production device behavior not verified.
APP_CONFIG v2 validator and additive migration tested; source preservation, contradiction handling and output overwrite refusal verified.
Architecture audit detects synthetic import-boundary violations. Generated sample has no recognized feature-layer files and reports PARTIAL.

evidence: A temporary two-app fixture produced separate project paths and reports; the real registry has zero app rows.
The control center documents registry-derived health and does not run builds.
A shared artifact index caused app B to receive app A's existing APK record in a reproducible fixture.

tests.name: python3 scripts/template_update_preview.py
tests.result: 26 source/template files; no missing, extra, or differing files

tests.name: python3 scripts/project_audit.py
tests.result: Structural checks passed; this does not verify V4-V7 completeness

aab.evidence: No AAB found; no production signing configuration or release key found.

security_findings.title: Cross-app artifact index association
security_findings.evidence: Shared root release_artifact_index.json is considered for every app; artifact validation checks path existence but not app-project containment. Two-app fixture reproduced app A artifact appearing under app B.
security_findings.required_action: Scope indexes and artifacts to the exact app project; add cross-app non-contamination regression tests.

security_findings.title: Canonical release build uses debug signing key
security_findings.evidence: release signingConfig is signingConfigs.getByName("debug"); no release keystore/configuration found.
security_findings.required_action: Do not distribute release artifacts. Configure secure production signing and verify it locally/CI after human approval.

security_findings.title: Generated app missing root ignore rules
security_findings.evidence: Fresh sample preflight reports missing project-root .gitignore. Local environment/secrets and build files may be accidentally included by downstream source-control operations.
security_findings.required_action: Generate and test a root .gitignore that covers Flutter outputs, local SDK config, local env and signing files.

security_findings.title: Heuristic secret scan is not comprehensive
security_findings.evidence: Canonical scan: 55 files, zero common pattern matches; sample: 56 files, zero common pattern matches. Git history unavailable and scanner does not provide comprehensive secret detection.

security_findings.title: No production approval/deployment audit system
security_findings.evidence: Registry update requires explicit execution flags and no publishing tool was found, but centralized tamper-resistant approval/audit records are absent.

privacy.evidence: No app-specific data processing, privacy policy, consent, Play Data safety, retention, or deletion review was available.

dependency_and_license_review.dependency_audit_limit: Static risk inventory only; no CVE, transitive vulnerability, or legal license checks.

recommendations: Complete and test V4.0 milestones 41-55, V5.0 milestones 56-75, and V7.0 milestones 76-85 against their intended specifications.
Fix release dashboard app-specific artifact scoping and add regression coverage.
Generate a root .gitignore for every new app.
Replace debug release signing with a reviewed production signing configuration; build and inspect an AAB only after approval.
Add actual app registrations and test per-app build/release evidence, cost reporting, and maintenance workflows.
Complete manual security, privacy, accessibility, performance, license and Play Store checks.
